trustCenter.title: Trust Center
trustCenter.subtitle: Your data security is our priority.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How we collect, use, and protect your data.

controller.title: 1. Data Controller
controller.content: UniPaws ("we", "us") is the data controller for personal data collected through the UniPaws app and the unipaws.gr website. For any questions about data processing, you can contact us at privacy@unipaws.gr.

dataCollected.title: 2. Data We Collect
dataCollected.account: Account details: Email, full name, phone, city.
dataCollected.pet: Pet data: Name, species, breed, blood type, photo, medical history.
dataCollected.location: Location data: For finding nearby blood donors and recording QR scans.
dataCollected.health: Medical data: Vaccinations, blood tests, lab results.
dataCollected.ai: AI data: Medical documents you upload are analyzed with artificial intelligence (Google Gemini) for data extraction.
dataCollected.push: Push tokens: For sending blood donation notifications.

legalBasis.title: 3. Legal Basis for Processing
legalBasis.consent: Consent: For push notifications and AI document analysis.
legalBasis.contract: Contract: For providing our services (account, blood donation).
legalBasis.legitimate: Legitimate interest: For improving services and security.

retention.title: 4. Data Retention
retention.content: Account data is retained as long as your account is active. Pet medical data is retained as long as the account exists or until you request deletion. QR scan data is retained for 12 months.

rights.title: 5. Your Rights (Articles 15-22 GDPR)
rights.access: Access: Right to receive a copy of your data.
rights.rectification: Rectification: Right to correct inaccurate data.
rights.erasure: Erasure: Right to delete your data ("right to be forgotten").
rights.portability: Portability: Right to receive data in a machine-readable format (JSON).
rights.objection: Objection: Right to object to certain processing.
rights.cta: To exercise your rights, visit the Data Request page.

contact.title: 6. Contact
contact.content: For any questions about your personal data, contact us at privacy@unipaws.gr or through the data request form.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.description: The rules and obligations for using UniPaws.

acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By using the UniPaws app and the unipaws.gr website, you accept these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use our services.

services.title: 2. Service Description
services.content: UniPaws provides: a pet blood donation network, digital identity via QR, medical history digitization with AI, and a pet services directory.

vetDisclaimer.title: 3. Veterinary Disclaimer
vetDisclaimer.content: UniPaws does NOT provide veterinary advice. AI analysis of lab results is purely informational and does not replace a veterinarian's assessment. Always consult a licensed veterinarian for your pet's care.

bloodDonation.title: 4. Blood Donation
bloodDonation.content: Pet blood donation is conducted exclusively under veterinary supervision. UniPaws facilitates connecting donors with recipients but bears no responsibility for the donation procedure.

gamification.title: 5. Scoring System (Heroes)
gamification.content: Points and achievements in the Heroes system are awarded automatically based on successful donations. They have no monetary value and cannot be transferred.

liability.title: 6. Limitation of Liability
liability.content: UniPaws is provided "as is". We bear no liability for any damages arising from the use of the app, including incorrect AI analysis results.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.description: How we use cookies on unipaws.gr.

what.title: What Are Cookies
what.content: Cookies are small files stored on your device that help us provide a better experience.

essential.title: Essential Cookies
essential.content: These cookies are necessary for the website to function. They include: Supabase authentication session, language preference, theme preference (light/dark).

analytics.title: Analytics Cookies
analytics.content: We use privacy-friendly analytics (no third-party cookies) to understand how you use the website. You can disable them at any time.

manage.title: Managing Cookies
manage.content: You can change your preferences at any time via the cookie banner at the bottom of the page.

banner.message: We use cookies to improve your experience.

dsar.title: Data Request
dsar.subtitle: Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the right to access, export, or delete your data.
dsar.loginRequired: You need to log in to the UniPaws app to submit a data request.
dsar.exportDescription: Receive a copy of all your data in JSON format.
dsar.deleteDescription: Permanently delete your account and all associated data.
dsar.success: Your request has been submitted successfully.
dsar.warning: Account deletion is irreversible. All your data will be anonymized.
